In [40]:
features = [
    'Study_Hours', 'Class_Attendance', 'Exam_Frequency', 
    'Assignment_Load', 'Sleep_Hours', 
    'Screen_Time', 'Peer_Pressure', 'Family_Support'
]
target = 'Stress_Score'

X = df[features]
y = df[target]
In [41]:
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42
)
In [42]:
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)


X_train_scaled_df = pd.DataFrame(X_train_scaled, columns=features)
X_test_scaled_df = pd.DataFrame(X_test_scaled, columns=features)
In [43]:
y_mean_baseline = np.full_like(y_test, fill_value=np.mean(y_train))
In [44]:
baseline_mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_mean_baseline)
baseline_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_mean_baseline)
baseline_r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_mean_baseline)

print("Baseline Performance")
print("MSE:", baseline_mse)
print("MAE:", baseline_mae)
print("R²:", baseline_r2)

In [45]:
linear_model = LinearRegression()

linear_model.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train)

linear_predictions = linear_model.predict(X_test_scaled)
In [46]:
linear_mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, linear_predictions)
linear_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, linear_predictions)
linear_r2 = r2_score(y_test, linear_predictions)

print("Linear Regression Performance")
print("MSE:", linear_mse)
print("MAE:", linear_mae)
print("R²:", linear_r2)

In [47]:
tree_default = DecisionTreeRegressor(random_state=42)
tree_default.fit(X_train, y_train)
tree_def_preds = tree_default.predict(X_test)
In [48]:
tree_def_mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, tree_def_preds)
tree_def_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, tree_def_preds)
tree_def_r2 = r2_score(y_test, tree_def_preds)

param_grid = {
    'max_depth': [3, 4, 5, 6],
    'min_samples_split': [5, 10, 20],
    'min_samples_leaf': [2, 5, 10]
}

grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    estimator=DecisionTreeRegressor(random_state=42),
    param_grid=param_grid,
    cv=5,
    scoring='neg_mean_squared_error',
    n_jobs=-1
)
grid_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

best_tree_model = grid_search.best_estimator_
tuned_tree_preds = best_tree_model.predict(X_test)

tuned_tree_mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, tuned_tree_preds)
tuned_tree_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, tuned_tree_preds)
tuned_tree_r2 = r2_score(y_test, tuned_tree_preds)

        'Decision Tree (Default)',

    'MSE': [baseline_mse, linear_mse, tree_def_mse, tuned_tree_mse],
    'MAE': [baseline_mae, linear_mae, tree_def_mae, tuned_tree_mae],
    'R²': [baseline_r2, linear_r2, tree_def_r2, tuned_tree_r2]
})
display(results)
